name: Kusumi Kiyotaka
source:
An apathetic useless teacher who often slacks off on the job.
The protagonist's Japanese history teacher.
Because he intends to quit his job he's always buying lottery tickets and other such things, but he never scratches them off.
He doesn't advise for any clubs so instead he looks after the courtyard garden.
